[[Sara Flenning|Sara]] (sister) }} '''Timothy Flenning''' was a human boy from [[Northwind]], where he lived with his mother [[Judith Flenning|Judith]] and sister [[Sara Flenning|Sara]]. While Judith was away from the house, he and Sara were kidnapped{{questlong|Alliance|28|Empty Houses}} by orcs of the [[Stormreaver clan]] that sought to take them to their hideout on the island of [[Balor]]. Along with many other captives, Timothy was experimented upon by the Stormreavers, resulting in his body liquifying and dissolving into ooze. Timothy's remains were later absorbed into the [[Remains of the Innocent]], deep beneath [[Stormwrought Castle]]. Upon the destruction of the amalgamation, all that was left of Timothy was his [[Etched Toy Sword]].{{questlong|Alliance|38|All That Is Left}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Flenning, Timothy}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Stormwind (kingdom)]] [[Category:Deceased characters]]
